title: When the Horizon Wakes
author: A. M. Iversen
blurb: Edmund Dravenmoor, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
